[ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ʀᴇᴘᴏsᴛ] A 17 y/o Chinese trans girl is currently being tortured by her family and needs help escaping from her sexual abuser—a child incarceration facility (“troubled teen industry”) instructor who recently became her stepfather. 

17-year-old Xiaoyou faced the darkest day of her life. For the past two years, her mother had become obsessed with so-called "internet addiction treatment centers" that could cure her child's "problems." Even though her child was among the top students in school, it couldn't change the parents' controlling nature.

Starting in August 2024, Xiaoyou was sent to Shandong Xinzhongzi Education Consulting Company, which was actually an internet addiction treatment center. At this center, the then 15-year-old Xiaoyou was repeatedly abused, beaten, and confined. This young boy's world was filled with despair.

In May 2025, Xiaoyou carried out her escape plan. Unfortunately, six days after successfully escaping, the person she least wanted to see appeared: Li Mouzhen, an "instructor" at the internet addiction treatment center.

"Instructor Li," along with several other so-called "instructors," repeatedly beat, threatened, and even sexually assaulted Xiaoyou while she was confined at "Shandong Xinzhongzi Education Consulting Company."

Tragically, Xiao You was once again subjected to unwarranted abuse by Li Mouzhen, and his mother's words completely shattered his mental world.

"I'm married to your Uncle Li. From now on, you'll call him Dad."

Since 2025, Xiao You has lived with this instructor, Li, becoming his nominal "son." Xiao You constantly sought opportunities to escape this terrifying place, but unfortunately, he failed time and time again.

In July 2026, Xiao You contacted some friends, tearfully begging them to save him, only to be detained again by Li Mouzhen, unable to contact the outside world, possibly on his way to another internet addiction treatment center.

We demand the protection of trans minors! We demand the abolition of child incarceration facilities and the troubled teen industry!
